# ViewFX

> Tailwind CSS plugin of theme transitions on the View Transitions API.

- GitHub: https://github.com/LuisitoLuis/viewfx
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@luisitoluis/viewfx

Install: `npm install @luisitoluis/viewfx`

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@luisitoluis/viewfx";
```

Put one effect class on `<html>` and wrap theme toggles in `document.startViewTransition`.
